entities.title: Content analysis
entities.summary: Turns one file's bytes into the facts zazzle-csharp-indexer stores per blob: git blob id, language, line count, trigram Bloom filter, symbols, identifier occurrences and a one-line digest.
entities.purpose: Holds the pure functions that depend only on a file's bytes and extension: blob analysis, the trigram Bloom filter, C# extraction with Roslyn, regex-based extraction for other languages, and the extraction of literals a regex must contain. Nothing here reads the disk, the store or the network.
boundaries: Storing the results is the store's job (src/Store.cs); deciding which files to analyse is the index's (src/Index/).
The search and reference tools in src/Tools/ use the Bloom filter, the literal extractor and the stored symbol format; they do not change them.
A change to what this folder produces for a blob must bump Store.ExtractorVersion (see contracts.json).
